snippet.title: Roguecraft DX - Evercade Gameplay
snippet.description:
Captured off the Evercade VS.

Winner of the Retro World Award at the 2025 Debug Indie Game Awards, this is an expanded version of an Amiga homebrew game, complete with new features, as well as in-game achievements. This is also the second single-game cartridge in the Evercade library, as the first one to have that distinction was Full Void, which came out in 2023.

Watch out for killer chickens!

Roguecraft DX (C) Badgerpunch Games
